summary: Renders a UI cursor selection rectangle, smoothly interpolating its bounds toward targets. Derives a target X from sub_45B5C0 plus an offset and a target Y from a threshold count scaled by a constant, then blends each of the two stored rectangle dimensions toward its target with a 0.4 factor once the delta exceeds a small epsilon; otherwise snaps. After interpolation the coordinates feed a float-to-int conversion and a render setup, several field getters compute corner offsets, and four edge transforms draw the rectangle through the render device. When no threshold count is active and the stored Y is already zero the state resets to zero instead.

operations.description: FloatArrayThresholdSearch returns the active count v7 used for both the activity guard and the target sizing.
Activity guard: proceed when the threshold count is nonzero or the stored Y dimension is already nonzero; otherwise the rectangle is inactive.
Target X: result of sub_45B5C0 on this object plus a constant offset 0.05.
Target Y: the threshold count scaled by a constant factor 0.035.
Interpolate stored X dimension at this+0x324 toward its target: blend by 0.4 when the delta magnitude exceeds the epsilon threshold, otherwise snap directly to the target.
Interpolate stored Y dimension at this+0x328 toward its target using the same 0.4 blend and epsilon-snap rule.
FloatToIntConversionDispatch converts the two interpolated coordinates from float to integer form.
Render setup call sub_4DCEE0 with four constant arguments beginning the rectangle primitive.
ConditionalCall invoked with zero, part of the render setup chain.
TwinFieldGetter_cf30 and TripleFieldGetter read the four offset values used to assemble the rectangle corner coordinates.
Corner coordinates assembled by summing the two field getter results into the four rectangle corners.
Four FloatVectorWithConditionalTransform calls draw the four rectangle edges through the render device pointer dword_8B8DC8.
Inactive branch: stored X dimension at this+0x324 is reset to zero.
